title: Counter over a three-line traced chart, mark close
summary: A big headline figure races up and settles while three coloured series trace across a dark chart one after another; the chart gives way to a dim oversized mark that lights up and shrinks, then a wordmark slides in as the mark breaks away.
use_when: A monthly or yearly recap with one headline figure and up to three growth series
Proving traction with a single number before the brand close
A silent social clip where the chart must read without VO
Dark product brands with a three-colour data palette

look.type_style: bold grotesk figures with thousands separator, ~17 % H, top-left; two-line muted caption ~3 % H below; tiny legend and axis labels ~1.5 % H; medium-weight sentence-case wordmark ~6 % H at the close

sfx.event: mark lights up after the chart clears
wordmark slides in as the mark breaks away

structure.shot: dark chart frame: baseline axis with start/end date labels and a three-item legend; headline figure top-left, two-line muted caption under it
structure.camera: static, locked frame (chart frame and figure never move)
structure.motion: axis + legend present from f0; figure fades grey->white ~23 fr (±0.25 s) while counting up from ~half its final value, easings.outExpo; caption words fade in left to right over ~30 fr (±0.25 s); series 1 (green) traces from the left, easings.linear-ish (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: same chart: series 2 (cyan) then series 3 (violet) trace under series 1; figure decelerates into its final value
structure.motion: series stagger ~22 fr (±0.25 s): starts at f8, f38, f60; each series traces ~52-60 fr (±0.25 s) to the right edge; counter lands f83 (2.77 s), total roll 75 fr, easings.outExpo

structure.shot: complete three-line chart with the settled figure, no motion
structure.motion: hold 45 fr (4.00-5.50 s); chart clears between 5.50 and 5.77 s, faster than the sheet resolution (±0.25 s), no cut in cuts.json

structure.shot: brand mark alone, centred, starting oversized (~50 % H) and dark grey
structure.camera: static frame; the mark itself scales
structure.motion: mark brightens dark grey->white over ~22 fr (light-on) and shrinks ~50 % H -> ~17 % H over ~37 fr, springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: small white mark centred on dark, held
structure.motion: hold ~45 fr (7.00-8.50 s), no visible motion

structure.shot: wordmark (product name) slides in from the left while the mark moves right and breaks into fragments; wordmark ends centred
structure.motion: wordmark enters from left, easings.outExpo ~15 fr (±0.25 s); mark slides right, splits into strokes and vanishes by 9.27 s; wordmark settles centred by 9.50 s and holds ~11 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: bg, fg, muted for caption/legend, three data colours for the series
params.content.figure: headline number, integer with thousands separator; counter starts near half of it
params.content.caption: two-line muted caption naming what the figure counts and the period
params.content.series: 1-3 series of ~25-30 points each, with a legend label per series
params.content.axis: start and end labels of the period on the baseline
params.timing.seriesStagger: frames between series starts (default ~22 at 30 fps)
params.timing.hold: frames the finished chart holds before the mark (default 45)

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s): counter values climb from ~49 % to 100 % of the final figure between 0.27 and 2.77 s, about 85 % of the climb in the first 0.5 s (outExpo shape). Series starts 0.27 / 1.27 / 2.00 s, each ends at the right edge ~2 s later. The chart-to-mark change at 5.50-5.77 s is not a cut (cuts.json near miss 5.70 s, score 5.1); its exact form is not measurable from sheets. Spring for the mark shrink (springs.heavy) and stagger frames are suggested defaults. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured: the reference is silent. Proposed term (not in vocabulary): mark-break-handoff, the mark slides aside and fragments while the wordmark takes its place (row 6).
